mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_snapshots (user_id, portfolio_id, snapshot_date, market_value_usd, market_value_krw, cost_basis_krw, price_pnl_krw, fx_pnl_krw, total_pnl_krw, return_rate, applied_fx_rate, is_fx_substituted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{portfolioId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{marketValueUsd}, #{marketValueKrw}, #{costBasisKrw}, #{pricePnlKrw}, #{fxPnlKrw}, #{totalPnlKrw}, #{returnRate}, #{appliedFxRate}, #{fxSubstituted}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE market_value_usd = VALUES(market_value_usd), market_value_krw = VALUES(market_value_krw), cost_basis_krw = VALUES(cost_basis_krw), price_pnl_krw = VALUES(price_pnl_krw), fx_pnl_krw = VALUES(fx_pnl_krw), total_pnl_krw = VALUES(total_pnl_krw), return_rate = VALUES(return_rate), applied_fx_rate = VALUES(applied_fx_rate), is_fx_substituted = VALUES(is_fx_substituted)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM holdings WHERE quantity > 0
